variants.headline: Household savings committed to a company plan
variants.body: The settler {founder} has committed household savings to a plan for {business}. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: An enterprise begins as a household risk
variants.body: Household savings have been put into a business plan by {founder}. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: A settler backs a business idea
variants.body: The founder {founder} has backed a plan for {business} with household savings. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
